about: The secreta of the formulary “Fifth Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Receive, O Lord, the prayers of the faithful together with the sacrificial offerings, that through these acts of devout worship we may pass unto heavenly glory. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
